models.validation: Percentages are soft targets, not FEDIAF minima; if supplied sum approximately 100 within tolerance and denominator kcal ME; fiber separate.

engine.goal: Fit kcal, meet official minima and relevant maxima simultaneously, use selected foods and selected available supplements only.
engine.step_one: check that mandatory ingredient and supplement profiles are verified sufficiently; distinguish unknown from 0
engine.step_two: assess feasibility for selected ingredient set with/without supplements, show probable needs as provisional
engine.step_three: joint constrained optimization of all food quantities plus supplement doses (no repeated greedy calcium additions)
engine.step_four: independent audit using frozen recipe snapshot
engine.variables: grams >=0 for food; grams or integer capsule counts for supplements; configurable min/max batch and rounding
engine.constraints: energy tolerance configurable; per-1000-kcal nutrient density based on actual recipe energy; Ca:P total ratio with Ca/P absolute minimum; nutrient non-negativity; upper limits when valid; product dose max when verified
objective_priority: required nutrient coverage with verified data
engine.infeasible: name failed constraints and plausible ingredient classes; do not fabricate supplement composition

energy_calculation.mer: RER * user-selected/qualified activity_factor; persist kcal override
energy_calculation.food_me: Use verified metabolizable energy per 100g, not human calorie labels without adjustment
energy_calculation.macro_kcal: Use canine-appropriate verified energy factors and consistent source definition; avoid double counting fiber, ash or water
energy_calculation.percentages: protein_kcal/total_me, fat_kcal/total_me, available_carbs_kcal/total_me; document residual and tolerance

ratios.calcium_phosphorus_ratio: SUM_Ca_g/SUM_P_g; block division by 0 and require both quantitative minima
ratios.omega6_omega3_ratio: SUM_total_omega6_g/SUM_total_omega3_g; only if both totals known and >0; if partial data unknown result UNVERIFIABLE
ratios.epa_dha: EPA_g + DHA_g; do not add again to total omega3 if EPA/DHA already included
ratios.methionine_cystine: methionine_g + cystine_g; avoid summing compound row with separate amino acids
ratios.unit_scaling: grams in foods * value_per_100g /100; capsule * verified amount per capsule

update_policy: Immutable versioned snapshots; weight-current changes no recalcs; target/standard/food profile change offers new version only after user confirmation; price-only update costs.
